service.name: typescript-code-graph
service.description: Deterministic file/module/symbol/import graph extraction and mechanical TypeScript refactor execution for Vrooli scenarios; wraps ts-morph and is consumed by architecture-cartographer and react-component-library.

hostTools.name: node
hostTools.reason: Node sidecar runtime (>=20) — runs the bundled ts-morph parser child process. The supervisor execs `node sidecar/dist/index.js` on API start; without Node, the API returns Unavailable on every Extract/RewriteApply call.
hostTools.notes: Version constraint: >=20.0.0. Pinned by the sidecar's package.json engines field and the esbuild target in sidecar/scripts/build.mjs.

hostTools.name: pnpm
hostTools.reason: Sidecar dependency installer; used only for the sidecar's own deps (ts-morph + devDeps). Never invoked against consumer projects.
hostTools.notes: Honours pnpm-lock.yaml via --frozen-lockfile for reproducible builds.

setup.description: Build API, sidecar bundle, and UI assets declared by the manifest-driven lifecycle contract

steps.name: check-node
steps.run: command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: node is required (>=20). Install Node.js 20+ before running setup; the API supervisor will spawn `node sidecar/dist/index.js`.' >&2; exit 1; }; NODE_MAJOR=$(node -e 'console.log(process.versions.node.split(".")[0])'); if [ "$NODE_MAJOR" -lt 20 ]; then echo "ERROR: node $NODE_MAJOR detected; sidecar requires node >=20." >&2; exit 1; fi
steps.description: Verify Node.js >=20 is on PATH (required by the sidecar runtime)

steps.name: check-pnpm
steps.run: command -v pnpm >/dev/null 2>&1 || command -v corepack >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'ERROR: pnpm (or corepack) is required to install sidecar deps. Install pnpm or enable corepack before running setup.' >&2; exit 1; }
steps.description: Verify pnpm/corepack is available for the sidecar build

steps.name: install-sidecar-deps
steps.run: cd sidecar && (corepack pnpm install --frozen-lockfile || pnpm install --frozen-lockfile)
steps.description: Install Node sidecar dependencies (ts-morph + devDeps) reproducibly via pnpm-lock.yaml

steps.name: build-sidecar
steps.run: cd sidecar && (corepack pnpm run build || pnpm run build)

steps.name: build-api
steps.run: cd api && GOWORK=off go mod download && GOWORK=off go build -o typescript-code-graph-api .

steps.name: install-ui-deps
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm install --ignore-workspace || pnpm install --ignore-workspace); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

steps.name: build-ui
steps.run: if [ -f ui/package.json ]; then cd ui && (corepack pnpm --ignore-workspace run build || pnpm --ignore-workspace run build); else echo 'ui/ not present yet'; fi

develop.description: Launch API and Vite dev server

steps.name: start-api
steps.description: Start Go API server in background

test.description: Execute phased test suite via test-genie

steps.name: check-temporal-models
steps.description: Verify formal flow artifacts via the flow-verifier scenario CLI

steps.name: run-tests
steps.description: Run all test phases via test-genie
